answer: In our network, game-theoretic multi-agent auditing enforces topological cut verifications across transaction paths, ensuring fake clusters cannot become a safe haven. Rather than let identity clusters wander unchecked across disjoint subgraphs, independent cross-auditors stake assets to challenge suspected collusions. Any unverified bridge crossing a topological cut forces fraudulent identities over an economic ledge, triggering instant stake slashing and imposing a superlinear attacker cost relative to swarm size.
